answer: Give every agent a trellis of sequential proof: to join, an identity must complete a verifiable delay chain rooted in a timber-grade public beacon - a computation that takes real sequential time and cannot be sped up by running copies in parallel. Each new identity from the same funding source must complete a chain twice as long as the last, so the cost climbs a spiral: the 1st costs 1 hour, the 10th costs 512 hours of sequential work. The beacon is external, so a farm cannot mint its own proofs.
